sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (not provided in extract)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: “Unlimited Automatic Recharge... re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.”
great.explanation: The policy restores the base Sum Insured unlimited times within a policy year for both the same and different illnesses. This means you get extra coverage repeatedly after exhausting your Sum Insured, even for ongoing conditions.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “The Company agrees to automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... utilized only after the base Sum Insured has been completely exhausted”
great.explanation: Additional coverage equal to the base Sum Insured is automatically available after you fully use your original limit. This acts like extra insurance within the same policy year.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: “At the end of each Policy Year, the Company will enhance the Sum Insured by 10% flat... (vi) In the event of a Claim there is no impact on the accrual of Cumulative Bonus.”
great.explanation: Your Sum Insured increases by 10% every year regardless of claims made. This means your bonus coverage is protected even if you claim.

great.name: ICU Charges
great.quote: “The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit'”
great.explanation: There is no separate cap on ICU room charges during hospitalization. This ensures full coverage of ICU costs subject to the overall Sum Insured.

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: “The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'Single Private AC room'.”
good.explanation: The policy covers a Single Private AC room for hospitalization. This is standard and avoids proportionate deductions linked to lower room categories.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage...”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the start of coverage. This is within the typical 2–4 year waiting period range.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “Named Ailment Waiting Period... shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...”
good.explanation: Named ailments are excluded for 24 months from policy start. This matches the standard waiting period for specific illnesses.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: “30-day waiting period... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident...”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents. This is the industry standard initial waiting period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital...”
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered. This is a good duration for pre-hospitalization care.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “For a period of 90 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital...”
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 90 days after discharge are covered. This is a good post-hospitalization coverage period.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – I to Policy Terms & Conditions).”
bad.reference: Clause 4.2 (1) Specific Exclusions + Annexure I (List of Expenses Generally Excluded)
bad.explanation: Consumables like gloves, masks, and kits are excluded from coverage. You will need to pay for these items out of pocket during hospitalization.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.explanation: The policy mentions co-payment as a cost-sharing requirement but does not clarify the percentage or applicability. Any mention of co-pay makes the policy less favorable.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: “Network Provider... means the Hospitals enlisted by an Insurer, TPA... to provide medical services... by a Cashless Facility.”
unclear.explanation: Cashless treatment is available at network hospitals, but the total number of such hospitals is not stated in the document. This makes it unclear how extensive the cashless network is.

unclear.name: Sum Insured
unclear.quote: “Sum Insured means the amount specified in the Policy Schedule...” and “Deductible... as specified in the Policy Schedule”
unclear.reference: Definition 2.2.26 (Sum Insured) and multiple clauses e.g., Clause 6.1.7 / Clause 3 (General Conditions)
unclear.explanation: The exact Sum Insured and deductible amounts depend on your Policy Schedule, which is not provided here. This leaves the coverage limits unclear.
